sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Close head-and-shoulders portrait of a young clean-shaven man, head turned a little toward screen-left with a matching leftward gaze. Short black hair swept neatly sideways from a part, visible curved dark eyebrows and a small closed neutral mouth. No hat, eyewear, moustache or chin beard; preserve the smooth upper lip and chin, and do not turn under-nose shadows into facial hair. Very dark navy high-neck tunic with a closed standing collar, thin pale edge/inner collar piping and a rectangular gold tab on each side carrying tiny pale round marks. No visible tie, shoulder boards, medals or sash. Crop leaves a small band of headroom and cuts the shoulders/lower chest at the canvas edges. Soft frontal/upper light highlights the forehead, near cheek and nose against darker side and uniform shade. Muted pale grey-green painted backing fills the whole rectangular canvas including all four corners, without photograph frame, paper note or transparent figure exterior. Source alpha255 throughout. Keep the complete background and dark clothes opaque. Under visible-source-differences-v1 the minute collar-tab mark interiors and individual hair strands cannot be proven exactly; preserve the visible mark groups rather than invent ranks. Keep clear source hair, brows, clean-shaven mouth/chin, head angle and high closed collar with a short broad mascot transition.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal close head-and-shoulders portrait of a bald middle-aged man with a very high bare crown and only a narrow rim of short dark brown hair at the sides/back. Keep the largely bald top, without inventing a full hairstyle. Dark firm eyebrows, slightly narrowed stern eyes, smooth clean-shaven cheeks/upper lip/chin, and a small tightly closed slightly downturned mouth. No hat, glasses, moustache or beard; nose/philtrum shade is not facial hair. Dark navy military tunic closed at a high standing collar, pale inner collar line and one small rectangular gold collar tab on each side with tiny bright dot-like marks. No visible tie, medals, sash or shoulder boards. Torso and face remain nearly frontal, with gaze slightly toward screen-left. Bright soft light falls on the screen-right forehead, nose and cheek, while screen-left face and uniform stay darker. Complete muted grey-green painted background fills all edges; no card frame, note or transparent exterior. Original alpha255 throughout. Preserve the complete opaque painted rectangle. Evidence limits under visible-source-differences-v1: tiny gold-tab internal marks and the exact fine side-hair texture are unreadable, so do not invent specific rank symbols. Preserve the bald crown, definite dark eyebrows, stern closed mouth and closed collar, adapting only the mascot anatomy with a short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Close almost frontal head-and-shoulders portrait of an older clean-shaven man, receding thin dark-grey hair combed straight back, high forehead, thin dark slightly angled brows and a serious closed mouth with a mild downturn. Eyes look almost forward with a slight screen-left bias. No hat, eyewear, moustache or chin beard; dark upper-lip and jaw shading must remain smooth skin rather than added hair. Slate blue-grey military tunic closes at a high standing collar. Each collar side has a red rectangular tab edged and striped in gold, and a round gold button is visible on the centreline below the collar. No visible tie, shoulder boards, medals or sash. Soft brighter light catches forehead, nose and screen-right cheek with deeper opposite-side shading. Tight bust crop cuts shoulders/chest at the lower canvas, while muted pale grey-green painted backing reaches all four corners and edges. No photograph frame, note, label or transparent figure exterior. Measured original alpha230..255 belongs to the complete painted rectangle, not an exterior cutout. Keep every dark clothing surface and all original background. Evidence limits under visible-source-differences-v1: minute gold/red tab symbols and individual grey hairs cannot be individually established; retain their actual grouped colours and shapes without inventing ranks. Keep the clear receding hair, brows, smooth mouth/chin and closed standing-collar layout with a short broad mascot fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Close nearly frontal head-and-shoulders naval portrait of a heavy-faced man with a serious closed mildly downturned mouth, dark brows partly beneath the visor, and short dark temple hair mostly covered by the cap. No eyewear, moustache, cheek beard or chin beard; keep the upper lip smooth and do not turn its skin shadow into a moustache. White/grey peaked naval cap with broad black band, glossy black visor, central gold anchor-and-wreath badge, horizontal gold cap braid and gold leaf decoration on the visor. Cap top is partly clipped by the upper edge. Dark navy notched-lapel coat over a grey shirt and dark tie; broad gold-edged shoulder boards with visible round gold buttons and tiny light marks extend to the side crop. Keep actual shoulder-board groups and no added chest medals. Face/gaze is near frontal with very slight screen-right orientation; soft directional highlights catch forehead/nose/cheeks against deep cap and coat shade. Pale muted grey-green painted background fills the complete canvas. No photo frame, overlapping note, text or transparent exterior. Measured alpha249..255 does not imply a figure cutout; retain the whole painted rectangle and opaque clothing/backing. Under visible-source-differences-v1 the exact tiny badge interior, shoulder marks and brow hairs under the visor cannot be read individually; preserve their visible placement and broad shapes without inventing named insignia. Keep the serious expression, clean chin, original cap and lapel/tie structure, fitting a short broad mascot neck.
